action.name: Live Release Reload
action.description: Detects completed LOOM deployments, gives connected sessions a configurable warning countdown, then refreshes them onto the newly committed release.

admin_settings.title: Live Release Reload
admin_settings.description: Keeps open LOOM browser sessions on the current completed deployment. Once the deployment manifest confirms a healthy release, LOOM warns users before refreshing instead of hard-reloading immediately.

fields.label: Reload warning countdown
fields.help: Default is 60 seconds. Users see a visible countdown and can choose Reload now.
